summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword-based ECS rules with matching unit tests. Rules: src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py. Tests: test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py, test_service_fargate.py. Results: 81 ECS tests pass; the rules and rule-collection suites pass (997 tests). Tests were run with PYTHONPATH=src because the venv's cfnlint resolves to a different checkout. black and ruff were unavailable, so formatting was checked manually for the 88-column limit. Nothing was committed, and no existing rule, helper, registry, schema, or docs file was changed.
